SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-11-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF STRIGIN, ANDREY IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT J&L AUTOMOTIVE REPAIR INC. DEFENDANTS EVIDENCE INCLUDES A WRITTEN ESTIMATE OF $250 TO REPAIR WINDOW GLASS. THE COURT DOESN'T FIND CREDIBLE PLAINTIFFS EVIDENCE THAT DEFENDANT AGREED TO REPLACE THE WINDOW REGULATOR ON A SUBSEQUENT DAY WITHOUT LABOR CHARGES. WRITTEN ESTIMATE OF $250 INCLUDES ONLY LABOR & PARTS FOR THE GLASS & NOT THE REGULATOR. THE COURT CONCLUDES THAT PLAINTIFF & HIS WITNESS MISUNDERSTOOD THE TERMS OF DEFENDANTS OFFER & IN LIGHT OF THE WRITTEN ESTIMATE, PLAINTIFF HASN'T CARRIED HIS BURDEN OF PROVING CLAIM STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
